description: Kernel-mystery probe: does Excel compute ERF/ERFC through its regularized incomplete gamma? Columns: A = x (2^-k, m*2^-30, uniform (0,0.5) and (0.5,6)); B = x*x; C = ERF.PRECISE(x); D = GAMMA.DIST(x^2,0.5,1,TRUE); E = CHISQ.DIST(2x^2,1,TRUE); F = ERFC.PRECISE(x); G = 1-D; H = CHISQ.DIST.RT(2x^2,1); I = GAMMA.DIST(x^2,0.5,1,FALSE). K1:K12 are the Gamma(0.5)/Gamma(1.5) constants.
